key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Slender herbaceous perennial, usually about 30–90 cm tall.

key_traits.label: Leaf arrangement
key_traits.text: Mostly whorled, commonly 3–4 leaves per node in TPWD's Texas treatment; other references may describe broader variation.

key_traits.label: Leaf morphology
key_traits.text: Sessile or nearly sessile; extremely narrow linear to filiform blades, usually somewhat revolute and essentially glabrous.

key_traits.label: Inflorescence
key_traits.text: Solitary or paired clusters at upper nodes, few- to many-flowered.

key_traits.label: Flower color
key_traits.text: Small greenish-white flowers, sometimes externally purple-flushed.

key_traits.label: Gynostegium detail
key_traits.text: Corona hoods with horns; flower structure is much smaller and more delicate than broad-leaved milkweeds such as A. viridis.
